shortDescription: On Polymarket’s “Warriors vs. Mavericks” market, the “Yes” probability for “Cooper Flagg: Points O/U 23.5” fell from 47.5% one hour ago to 26.5% currently, a 21% decline. According to ChainCatcher, the option’s probability saw a sharp fluctuation.
